clips.title: The story
paras: Sara Balloo asks a trusted Alliance champion to carry her handwritten letter to King Magni Bronzebeard. Grieving in Ironforge, she cannot face the monarch herself and trusts the champion to bring her appeal before him.

Sara Balloo sends a humble appeal to Ironforge's throne. Grieving, she cannot bring herself to face the High Seat, so she seeks an adventurer loyal to the Alliance to carry her words. Her message asks King Magni Bronzebeard to look toward the private mourning and sacrifices of ordinary dwarven families who serve the kingdom.
